stories.title: More visible policing and quicker responses wanted, North Wales police commissioner’s survey finds
stories.summary: More visible policing and quicker responses are among the things people in North Wales have asked for in a survey run by Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin’s office. stories.title: Health board boss expresses concern over 24-hour A&E waits in North Wales
stories.summary: A health board boss has expressed “disgust” at seeing ambulances waiting outside hospitals and “sadness” that 24 hour waits in A&E are “becoming the norm” in North Wales. stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS elected chair of Senedd Legislation Committee
stories.summary: A Reform UK Wales Member for Fflint Wrecsam, has been elected Chair of the Senedd’s Legislation Committee following a secret ballot held during Tuesday’s Plenary. Cristiana Emsley MS, who was elected in May 2026, secured 52 votes, while her rival candidate, Cai Parry-Jones (Reform UK Wales, Caerdydd Ffynnon Taf), received 15 votes. Seven Members abstained

stories.title: Flint lifeboat volunteer marks station’s 60th anniversary with River Dee litter challenge
stories.summary: A Flint RNLI volunteer is aiming to clear 60 bags of rubbish from the banks of the River Dee to mark the lifeboat station’s 60th anniversary. stories.title: Former Land Girl Kate Corbett marks 100th birthday with party at Halkyn Cricket Club
stories.summary: A Bagillt woman who drove tractors as a Land Girl during the Second World War has celebrated her 100th birthday at Halkyn Cricket Club.
